test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The present paper throws light on the __nexus__ between the academic performance and mental health of children.
solution: The correct answer is **link**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Nexus: **a complicated series of connections between different people or things. (विभिन्‍न व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं के बीच जटिल संबंध) • **Link: **a connection or relationship between two or more people or things. (दो या अधिक व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं के बीच संपर्क सूत्र या संबंध) • Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Dispute: **a disagreement or argument between two people, groups or countries. ((दो व्‍यक्तियों, समूहों या देशों के बीच) विवाद, झगड़ा) • **Alignment: **arrangement in a straight line or parallel to something else. (सीध, संरेखण) • **Incongruence: **the state of not being suitable or not fitting well with something else. (असंगति) 188:Tb44, The correct answer is **trouble**.
